name: mcp-office-suite
description: One install for the whole freelancer office suite: time tracking, price watching, spreadsheets and PDF invoicing, proxied behind a single MCP server.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: business_set
tools.description: The ONE business profile for the whole suite: name, address, VAT id, bank details and defaults (currency, tax rate, terms, prefix, timezone). Saved to the shared profile every other server reads. Call it once, first.

tools.name: client_add
tools.description: Store a client so invoices can refer to them by name. Re-adding the same name updates the stored details.

tools.name: client_list
tools.description: List every stored client with their id, address, email and VAT id.

tools.name: invoice_create
tools.description: Create an invoice for a client from a list of items. Allocates the next invoice number (never reused) and returns the stored invoice with its subtotal, discount, one tax line per rate and the total.

tools.name: invoice_from_hours
tools.description: Shortcut for the common case: bill one client for N hours at an hourly rate. Creates and returns a single-line invoice, converting the rate into target_currency when you supply fx_rates, and echoing back any entry_ids.

tools.name: invoice_list
tools.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by status (unpaid, paid, partial), client, and an issue-date range.

tools.name: invoice_get
tools.description: Return the full stored record for one invoice number, including every line and tax breakdown.

tools.name: invoice_mark_paid
tools.description: Record a payment. It ADDS to what is already paid (never replaces it) and refuses an amount that would overpay, naming the open balance. Omit amount to pay off the rest in full.

tools.name: invoice_pdf
tools.description: Call this tool to render a stored invoice as an A4 PDF you can send. Returns the path of the file written.

tools.name: overdue_report
tools.description: Answer "which invoices are overdue?": every unpaid or partly paid invoice past its due date, with days overdue, the outstanding amount per invoice and the outstanding total per currency. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
